outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic paired with western blot images; it contains no plotted averages requiring individual data points.

Bar charts show single densitometry quantification values per antibody from one western blot experiment (no error bars indicating replicate averaging), so there is no mean/average requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel C is a heatmap of normalized protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel D is a violin plot, which already displays the full data distribution and is exempt from needing overlaid individual points.
Panel E bar charts (mean ± SD, n=4) show individual data points as overlaid dots for each replicate on top of the bars.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted molecular structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a scatterplot; individual points are inherently the data shown, so overlay of additional individual points is not applicable.
Panel H is a scatterplot of HTT vs HAP40 abundance across individual IP-MS experiments; scatterplots are exempt.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot; individual samples are already plotted as points, so this is exempt from the check.
Panel J consists of PCA scatterplots (striatum, cortex, cerebellum); scatterplots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
